feeds.title: Mister Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Don is a respected member of the Tarot community, attending International Tarot Conferences in Australia and overseas. He is a founding member of the Tarot Group of South Australia. Tarot is a passion that continues to guide his life on many practical and spiritual levels. The posts cover the art of Tarot reading and offer insightful Tarot card meanings. Discover how to do free Tarot readings for yourself!

feeds.title: THE INTUITIVE GEMINI Blog
feeds.description: Rebecca is a mum to two young children and grateful to live under the stars of the Gold Coast, Australia. She has had an interest in Tarot and spirituality for as long as she can remember. She loves to read for other women, to give guidance, offer clarity, and quite often glimpses of their love and life purpose. Her blog posts shot and informative articles about Tarot and spirituality.

feeds.title: Tarot in Action Blog
feeds.description: Ruanna's love for Metaphysics and Tarot has sent her on a wonderful journey. No matter what has happened in her life she has always come back to Tarot for guidance and clarification. Her aim, as always, is to provide guidance and clear direction as a way-shower and a change agent, so that you are empowered to be in control of your own life's journey. Blog posts about Astrology, Tarot, Numerology, healing news, and inspiration to keep you informed and updated.

feeds.title: Roosy Spirit Tarot Readings Blog
feeds.description: Roosy's spiritual journey began at a very young age when she lived in her own world. In her later years, she developed different skills within the Spiritual, Metaphysical, and New Age spheres including working with her Spirit Guides, Tarot, Mediumship, Angel cards, Oracle cards, Energy Healing, Pranic Healing, and Counselling. She offers knowledge on psyche, Tarot, spirituality, and more on her blog.

feeds.title: The Tarot Au Blog
feeds.description: Hemina Shah is based in Melbourne, Australia, and provides readings for clients globally. Discover a captivating Tarot blog dedicated to tarot readers and lovers of the Tarot. Dive into the depths of Tarot cards and gain new insights to expand your knowledge.

feeds.title: Revealing Light Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Maryann is a clairvoyant, medium, teacher, and counselor, and the founder of several successful spiritual social media platforms. She is also an author and professional writer and communicator. She began Revealing Light Tarot in 2018 because she felt a calling to take her spiritual work further, following a successful journey through cancer, chemotherapy, and radiation treatment. She writes about energy, dream space, spiritual awakening, and more.

feeds.title: The Biddy Tarot Podcast: Tarot | Intuition | Empowerment
feeds.description: Welcome to the Biddy Tarot Podcast, where you'll discover how to trust your intuition, access your inner power and bring a little magic into your everyday life, with Tarot as your guide. Join your host, world-renowned Tarot leader and mentor, and best-selling author, Brigit Esselmont, as she shares her practical wisdom and advice on how to become a better Tarot reader, and how to use the Tarot cards for self-empowerment, personal growth and manifestation. Plus, listen to inspiring conversations with modern mystics and spiritual leaders from around the world...

feeds.title: Top Hat Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Top Hat Tarot comprises one tarot reader, Julia. Julia has worked in events for over 15 years with extensive experience at The Star Casino in Sydney as one of their main entertainment suppliers. A public speaker, producer, and production tour manager for a major theatrical show she regularly travels all around Australia in this capacity. The blog offers interesting articles on readings, changing times, Tarot, discovery, and more.

feeds.title: New Angel Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Renee is the person behind New Angel Tarot. This blog is a space where you can receive support, insight, and spiritual guidance from someone who's walked the earth for almost 50 years, been to hell and back, and has finally arrived at the beginning of her life. Her pursuit of esoteric knowledge is a lifelong journey, however, She has spent decades on her career as a successful designer and creative leader in advertising and now Tarot is her profession and life path. Browse the blog for writings, musings, observations, and conversations about Tarot.

feeds.title: Dhyani's Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Dhyani D'Souza is a Spiritual Advisor at Dhyani's Tarot! Her desire is to create an environment that you will feel safe in, to heal, to connect, and to empower you to be all that you can be! As a Tarot Advisor, she has discovered the profound impact of combining Tarot and Oracle cards. This allows for a deeper understanding that she can then share, to enrich the lives of those who have entrusted her with this great privilege. She offers an interesting take on life, spirituality, Tarot cards, and more.

feeds.title: Speak in Spells » Tarot
feeds.description: Alathryne is a witch by birth; she loves creating, crafting, and weaving magic. Ever since she was a child, she had (and still has) a fascination with odd-looking glass bottles. Her Nan, an Irish witch, would tell her all about the Fae, the plants, and the magic within her garden. Read more about Tarot cards, astrology, and more.
